name: ai-skills
description: Standards-based SDLC and code-review workflows for ChatGPT Work, Codex, and Claude Code.

interface.longDescription: Plan, analyze, design, implement, test, and document software changes through traceable workflows shared across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Use SDLC Planning to define the scope, goals, roles, estimates, risks, and readiness for this project.
Use SDLC Analysis to turn this project brief into a traceable Software Requirements Specification.
Use SDLC Design to map the architecture, user interfaces, data models, and integration contracts.
Use SDLC Coding to implement this approved requirement and design as tested production code.
Use SDLC Testing to check this implementation for functional, security, and performance problems.
